description: A shuttered unit at street level with a door beside it, and the door is the business. Up the right-hand side of the building, from the pavement to the first floor, runs a tall narrow window in four panes, and behind the glass, lit all night, are the flash sheets: hundreds of designs inked on card and pinned edge to edge up the whole stair. From the far pavement it is a vertical strip of light on a dark building and it is the only thing of its shape anywhere in Coldwater. Painted over the door, in an outlined script somebody was clearly paid well for: NO REGERTS.
name: No Regerts
